mapper.sql: id, user_id AS userId, provider, merchant_reference AS merchantReference, client_request_id AS clientRequestId, request_hash AS requestHash, plan_code_snapshot AS planCodeSnapshot, accepted_plan_version AS acceptedPlanVersion, provider_recurring_id AS providerRecurringId, provider_data_key_ciphertext AS providerDataKeyCiphertext, provider_token_ciphertext AS providerTokenCiphertext, token_expire_at AS tokenExpireAt, status, consented_at AS consentedAt, revoked_at AS revokedAt, revoke_requested_at AS revokeRequestedAt, revoke_next_attempt_at AS revokeNextAttemptAt, revoke_lease_until AS revokeLeaseUntil, revoke_attempt_count AS revokeAttemptCount, revoke_last_error AS revokeLastError, version
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO reading_subscription_mandate (user_id, provider, merchant_reference, client_request_id, request_hash, plan_code_snapshot, accepted_plan_version, status) VALUES (#{userId}, 'VNPAY_RECURRING', #{merchantReference}, #{clientRequestId}, #{requestHash}, #{planCodeSnapshot}, #{acceptedPlanVersion}, 'PENDING')
mapper.select: SELECT FROM reading_subscription_mandate WHERE merchant_reference=#{merchantReference} LIMIT 1 FOR UPDATE
SELECT FROM reading_subscription_mandate WHERE merchant_reference=#{merchantReference} LIMIT 1
SELECT FROM reading_subscription_mandate WHERE user_id=#{userId} AND provider='VNPAY_RECURRING' AND status='ACTIVE' LIMIT 1
SELECT FROM reading_subscription_mandate WHERE user_id=#{userId} AND provider='VNPAY_RECURRING' AND status IN ('PENDING', 'ACTIVE', 'REVOKE_PENDING') ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE reading_subscription_mandate SET provider_recurring_id=#{providerRecurringId}, provider_data_key_ciphertext=#{providerDataKeyCiphertext}, version=version+1 WHERE merchant_reference=#{merchantReference} AND status='PENDING' AND provider_recurring_id IS NULL AND provider_data_key_ciphertext IS NULL

UPDATE reading_subscription_mandate SET provider_token_ciphertext=#{providerTokenCiphertext}, provider_data_key_ciphertext=NULL, token_expire_at=#{tokenExpireAt}, status='ACTIVE', consented_at=#{consentedAt}, version=version+1 WHERE id=#{id} AND version=#{expectedVersion} AND status='PENDING' AND provider_recurring_id IS NOT NULL
UPDATE reading_subscription_mandate SET status='FAILED', provider_data_key_ciphertext=NULL, version=version+1 WHERE id=#{id} AND version=#{expectedVersion} AND status='PENDING'

UPDATE reading_subscription_mandate SET status='REVOKE_PENDING', revoke_requested_at=#{now}, revoke_next_attempt_at=#{now}, revoke_lease_until=NULL, revoke_last_error=NULL, version=version+1 WHERE user_id=#{userId} AND provider='VNPAY_RECURRING' AND status='ACTIVE'

UPDATE reading_subscription_mandate SET revoke_lease_until=#{leaseUntil}, revoke_attempt_count=revoke_attempt_count+1, version=version+1 WHERE id=#{id} AND status='REVOKE_PENDING' AND revoke_next_attempt_at<=#{now} AND (revoke_lease_until IS NULL OR revoke_lease_until<=#{now})
mapper.select: SELECT FROM reading_subscription_mandate WHERE id=#{id} LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE reading_subscription_mandate SET status='REVOKED', provider_token_ciphertext=NULL, token_expire_at=NULL, revoked_at=#{revokedAt}, revoke_next_attempt_at=NULL, revoke_lease_until=NULL, revoke_last_error=NULL, version=version+1 WHERE id=#{id} AND version=#{expectedVersion} AND status='REVOKE_PENDING'

UPDATE reading_subscription_mandate SET revoke_next_attempt_at=#{nextAttemptAt}, revoke_lease_until=NULL, revoke_last_error=#{lastError}, version=version+1 WHERE id=#{id} AND version=#{expectedVersion} AND status='REVOKE_PENDING'
mapper.select: SELECT id AS mandateId, user_id AS userId, merchant_reference AS merchantReference, provider_recurring_id AS providerRecurringId, status, revoke_requested_at AS revokeRequestedAt, revoke_next_attempt_at AS revokeNextAttemptAt, revoke_lease_until AS revokeLeaseUntil, revoke_attempt_count AS revokeAttemptCount, revoke_last_error AS revokeLastError, update_time AS updateTime, version FROM reading_subscription_mandate WHERE status=#{status} ORDER BY update_time ASC, id ASC LIMIT #{limit}
SELECT FROM reading_subscription_mandate WHERE id=#{id} LIMIT 1 FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE reading_subscription_mandate SET revoke_next_attempt_at=#{now}, revoke_lease_until=NULL, version=version+1 WHERE id=#{id} AND version=#{expectedVersion} AND status='REVOKE_PENDING' AND (revoke_lease_until IS NULL OR revoke_lease_until<=#{now})
